cohort: The cohort consisted of 1,710 Emirati and non-Emirati mothers attending healthcare follow-up centers in Abu Dhabi, UAE.
finding: Factors significantly associated with advanced maternal age were higher parity, non-Arab ethnicity, maternal employment, pre-pregnancy maternal overweight, pre-pregnancy maternal obesity, and cesarean delivery, while no association was found with parent's education, family income, child gender, preterm birth, or low birth weight.
mod_finding: Advanced maternal age was significantly associated with cesarean delivery (AOR = 2.44).
